lines.en: label nikispring6:
Three hours later...
lines.zh: 三个小时后……

lines.en: scene nikiverysad1
: I entered as a girl...but I emerge as a woman.
lines.zh: : 我进去时是个女孩……出来时成了女人。

lines.en: : I formally apologize for all of the things I did to you in that room. As your brother, I should know better.
lines.zh: : 我正式为我在那个房间里对你做的一切道歉。作为你的哥哥，我本该更懂事。

lines.en: : Apologize? Are you kidding? That was the best night of my life.
lines.zh: : 道歉？你在开玩笑吗？那是我这辈子最棒的一晚。

lines.en: : Will I be paying for it in the morning? Probably. But that is a problem for tomorrow’s Noriko, when tonight’s Noriko is no longer dealing with the aftershock of over a hundred orgasms.
lines.zh: : 明天早上会不会付出代价？大概会。但那是明天那个 Noriko 的问题了，今晚这个 Noriko 还在消化一百多次高潮的余震。

lines.en: : Do you know what time it is by any chance?
lines.zh: : 你知不知道现在几点了？

lines.en: scene nikiverysad2
: Like 3:30 last I checked?
lines.zh: : 我上次看是三点半左右？

lines.en: scene nikiverysad3
: Want to go take a shower together? Because my body says “sleep,” but neither my mind nor the hotel staff will ever forgive me if I crawl into my futon drenched in sweat and brother juice.
lines.zh: : 要一起去洗澡吗？因为我的身体在喊「睡觉」，可要是我浑身是汗、沾着哥哥的汁液就这么钻进被褥，我的理智和酒店员工都不会原谅我。

lines.en: : Onii-chan? Shower? We can go separately if you are sufficiently grossed out by me right now. Which you may be and I would not blame you for.
lines.zh: : 哥？洗澡？如果你现在已经被我恶心到了，我们可以分开洗。你可能会被恶心到，那我也不会怪你。

lines.en: : Not that.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。

lines.en: : Look down.
lines.zh: : 往下看。

lines.en: scene black
scene nikiverysad4
: Nee-chan?...
lines.zh: : Nee-chan？……

lines.en: : Have you...been outside the door the whole time?
lines.zh: : 你……一直在门外吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I’m...gonna let you handle this one.
lines.zh: : 我……还是让你来处理这个吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Goodnight, Noriko. I’ll see you in the morning.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Noriko。明早见。

lines.en: scene black
: Goodnight...Onii-chan. Onee-chan.
lines.zh: : 晚安……哥。Onee-chan。

lines.en: scene nikiverysad5
: Hah...
Where do I even begin?
lines.zh: 我该从哪儿说起？

lines.en: At what point could I even start my explanation that wouldn’t cause her head to sink even further into her knees?
lines.zh: 我要从哪一句开始解释，才能不让她的头埋得更低、更深地抵进膝盖里？

lines.en: There isn’t one, is there?
lines.zh: 没有的，对吧？

lines.en: I’ve really fucked up this time.
lines.zh: 这次我真的搞砸了。

lines.en: So much so that I don’t even know if I should be pivoting to damage control or just piling more pain onto her in an effort to tear her away from other doors in the future.
lines.zh: 糟到我甚至不知道该转向止损，还是干脆再往她身上堆更多痛苦，好让她日后远离别的门。

lines.en: Because there will be more. And she was always going to find out one way or another.
lines.zh: 因为以后还会有更多。而她迟早都会发现，无论如何。

lines.en: I just didn’t expect her to subject herself to the same hurt I thrust upon her when it would have been infinitely easier to just...walk away and face me later.
lines.zh: 我只是没想到，她会让自己承受我强加给她的那种痛——明明她大可以一走了之，回头再来面对我，那样要容易得多。

lines.en: She’s not like me, though.
lines.zh: 可她不像我。

lines.en: She’s never been like me.
lines.zh: 她从来都不像我。

lines.en: She doesn’t run. She doesn’t hide. And when something hurts or scares her, she does what any adult should do and just...confronts it.
lines.zh: 她不逃。她不躲。当有什么东西伤到她、吓到她，她会像任何成年人该做的那样，只是……去面对它。

lines.en: I envy that. I envy her. I always will and I always have. But there’s a brief respite during times like this. For despite how much I am hurting, I can’t imagine it even compares to what she feels.
lines.zh: 我羡慕这个。我羡慕她。我过去一直羡慕，将来也会一直羡慕。但在这种时刻会有一丝短暂的喘息——因为无论我有多痛，我都没法想象那比得上她的感受。

lines.en: That’s always been her greatest weakness. That unwavering faith in me. The belief that I can be better if she just presses on and breaks through.
lines.zh: 这一直是她最大的弱点。那份对我毫不动摇的信任。那种只要她咬牙撑下去、捅破那层纸，我就会变好的信念。

lines.en: But everyone feels that way. And when everyone feels that way, what am I supposed to do?
lines.zh: 可每个人都这么想。当每个人都这么想的时候，我该怎么办？

lines.en: It could have just as easily been Noriko in her sister’s place tonight. The same way it is with Ami every night now. And I can’t please everyone.
lines.zh: 今晚站在她姐姐位置上的，本可以同样轻易地换成 Noriko。就像现在每晚都是 Ami 一样。而我没法让所有人都满意。

lines.en: But that doesn’t stop me from trying. And failing. And winding up next to girls that I really do wish would just...go away.
lines.zh: 可这并不妨碍我一直去试。然后失败。然后躺在那些我真心希望她们……干脆消失的姑娘身边。

lines.en: Because for all she’s done for me...with me...
lines.zh: 因为，尽管她为我做了那么多……跟我一起……

lines.en: She’s the one I want to hurt the least.
lines.zh: 她是我最不想伤害的人。

lines.en: But that just means I’m forced to hurt her the most.
lines.zh: 可这也意味着，我不得不伤她最深。

lines.en: And it might not make sense to you, but it’s what I’ve always done when it comes to her.
lines.zh: 这也许说不通，但面对她的时候，我一直是这么做的。

lines.en: It’s all to protect her. From whatever I may do. From whatever fears may come.
lines.zh: 这一切都是为了保护她。保护她免于我可能做出的任何事。免于任何可能到来的恐惧。

lines.en: She just...keeps coming back.
lines.zh: 可她……还是一次次回来。

lines.en: How much can this girl take?
lines.zh: 这个姑娘究竟能承受多少？

lines.en: : Five hours...
lines.zh: : 五个小时……

lines.en: : You had sex with her for five hours.
lines.zh: : 你跟她做了五个小时。

lines.en: : My sister...
lines.zh: : 我妹妹……

lines.en: : My little fucking sister who loves you with all her heart and has done nothing but look up to you her entire life...
lines.zh: : 我那个他妈的小妹妹，全心全意爱着你，这辈子除了仰视你什么都没做过……

lines.en: : And you do that?
lines.zh: : 而你就那样对她？

lines.en: : The same things that were done to you?...That turned your life into a living hell?!
lines.zh: : 就是那些曾经发生在你身上的事？……那些把你的人生变成活地狱的事？！

lines.en: : Where did I go wrong?...
lines.zh: : 我到底哪里做错了？……

lines.en: : What else could I have done?...
lines.zh: : 我还能做些什么？……

lines.en: : There is nothing, Niki.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有，Niki。

lines.en: : There is nothing you could have done that would have changed this outcome.
lines.zh: : 你无论做什么，都不可能改变这个结局。

lines.en: : Then why did you let me try?!
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还让我白费力气？！

lines.en: : Because trying to stop you would just make you try even harder. That’s what you do.
lines.zh: : 因为想拦着你，只会让你更用力。你就是这个性子。

lines.en: : You’ve always wanted to fix me. But it’s wanting that that’s going to destroy you in the end.
lines.zh: : 你一直想治好我。可最终会毁掉你的，正是这份「想」。

lines.en: : If this...isn’t the end right now.
lines.zh: : 如果……现在这一刻还不是结局的话。

lines.en: : Are you breaking up with me then?...
lines.zh: : 那你是要跟我分手吗？……

lines.en: : Shouldn’t I be the one asking you that question? Because it’d be hard to see you as anything but an idiot if you’re not. And I don’t want you to ruin my image of you.
lines.zh: : 这话难道不该由我来问你吗？因为如果你不是，我就很难不把你当成白痴。而我可不想让你毁掉你在我心里的形象。

lines.en: : Guess you finally know about what was going on with Sekai then. Took you long enough.
lines.zh: : 看来你终于知道我和 Sekai 之间的事了。你可真够慢的。

lines.en: : I’ve always known...
lines.zh: : 我一直都知道……

lines.en: : I just didn’t want it to be real.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让它成真。

lines.en: : And I don’t want this to be real either.
lines.zh: : 而我也不想让这件事成真。

lines.en: : I keep sitting here...with my eyes closed...hoping I’ll just...wake up and this will all be a part of some nightmare.
lines.zh: : 我就这么一直坐着……闭着眼睛……盼着只要……醒过来，这一切就都是某场噩梦的一部分。

lines.en: : But now my...knees are soaked from crying into them...my eyes hurt. And I’m hungry. And I just want this to be over.
lines.zh: : 可现在我的……膝盖被泪水浸透了……眼睛也疼。而且我饿了。我只想让这一切赶紧结束。

lines.en: : Why are you like this, Akira?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么是这副样子，Akira？……

lines.en: : Why do you go out of your way to make things even worse for yourself?...
lines.zh: : 为什么你非要费尽心思，把事情弄得更糟？……

lines.en: : I don’t understand...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……

lines.en: scene nikiverysad6
: You’re not even supposed to be here...This weekend was for me! So I could do something to make my life better without you getting in the way again!
lines.zh: : 你本来就不该在这儿……这个周末是我的！好让我做点什么，让我的生活变好一点，不用你再来碍事！

lines.en: : And you fucking ruined it! Why didn’t you just stay at home?! That’s all you had to do!
lines.zh: : 而你他妈的把它毁了！你为什么不待在家里？！你只要做到这个就够了！

lines.en: : So you’d be happier just continuing to lead a life of delusion? Where you willfully ignore the things I’m doing behind the scenes?
lines.zh: : 所以你宁愿继续过着自欺欺人的生活？故意对我在背地里做的事视而不见？

lines.en: : No, you fucking idiot! You’re over-complicating things again! I just wanted to bond with Ami and my sister!
lines.zh: : 不是，你这个白痴！你又把事情想复杂了！我只是想跟 Ami 和我妹妹增进感情！

lines.en: : Not everything has to be some super deep and complex mental puzzle about you getting molested as a child! And yeah, that was horrible! But this world doesn’t revolve around you!
lines.zh: : 不是什么事都得变成关于你小时候被性侵的超级深刻复杂的心理谜题！没错，那很可怕！可这个世界不是围着你转的！

lines.en: : Just let me have something! Anything! To distract me from the fact that I’ve wasted two thirds of my life on someone who will never love me as much as I love him!
lines.zh: : 就让我拥有点什么吧！什么都行！好让我别再想着——我把人生三分之二的时间，都浪费在一个永远不会像我爱他那样爱我的人身上！

lines.en: : I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 对不起……

lines.en: : No, you’re not! You’re just saying you are because it’s the easiest fucking way to roll over and submit to how fucking weak and stupid you are! Why won’t you just fight?!
lines.zh: : 不，你没有！你只是在说「对不起」，因为那是他妈的最省事的方式，好让你翻个身、屈服于自己有多他妈软弱愚蠢！你为什么就是不反抗？！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how fucking annoying this is?! Being a fountain of fucking moral and mental support for you every day, just to watch you set yourself on fire?! Just to be ignored?!
lines.zh: : 你知道这有多他妈让人火大吗？！每天当你的道德和精神支柱，就为了看你把自己点着？！就为了被你无视？！

lines.en: scene nikiverysad7
: That’s why I ask if there’s something else I could have done...
lines.zh: : 所以我才问，还有没有别的什么是我本可以做的……

lines.en: : Something I could have changed that would have stopped you from perpetuating this fucking death spiral where you destroy the only meaningful connections you’ve ever had with anyone.
lines.zh: : 有什么是我本可以改变，好阻止你继续这个该死的死亡螺旋——在里面毁掉你这一生仅有的、真正有意义的联结。

lines.en: : Honestly, I think some people are just...destined to live terrible, hurtful lives.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我觉得有些人就是……注定要过糟糕又伤人的一生。

lines.en: : Honestly, I think you’re a fucking moron. That’s the dumbest thing I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我觉得你是个该死的蠢货。这是我听过最蠢的话。

lines.en: : If it’s so dumb, then why has my life been nothing but endless torment from the moment I was born?
lines.zh: : 既然这么蠢，那为什么我从出生那一刻起，人生就只有无尽的折磨？

lines.en: : Why has my life been nothing but endless torment from the moment I met you?
lines.zh: : 为什么我从遇见你的那一刻起，人生就只有无尽的折磨？

lines.en: : Because you met me, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为你遇见了我，显而易见。

lines.en: : Oh, good. At least you’re not a complete moron if you can acknowledge that then.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。至少你能承认这一点，说明你还不算彻底的蠢货。

lines.en: : You get what I’m saying though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过你明白我的意思吧？

lines.en: : What, that all of these years have been fucking wasted trying to convince someone who’s never known happiness that the concept itself isn’t a fucking myth?
lines.zh: : 什么，是说这么多年都他妈白费了，就为了说服一个从不知幸福为何物的人——幸福这个概念本身不是他妈的神话？

lines.en: : And here I thought that being a father would get you to wake the fuck up. Here I thought trying to show you what a real family felt like might finally change you.
lines.zh: : 我还以为当了父亲能让你他妈的醒过来。我还以为，试着让你体会一个真正的家是什么感觉，终归能改变你。

lines.en: : But Ami’s just as deranged as you are and now you’re fucking my sister too. So silly me, right? Silly fucking Niki for trying again! When all she wants to do is help!
lines.zh: : 可 Ami 跟你一样疯，现在你连我妹妹都睡了。啊，我真傻，对吧？傻透了的 Niki 居然又试了一次！而她想做的只是帮忙而已！

lines.en: : You and Noriko have that in common...that whole “wanting to help people” thing.
lines.zh: : 你和 Noriko 有共同点……就是那个「想帮助别人」的毛病。

lines.en: : Mhm! Want to know what else we have in common now too?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼！想知道我们现在还有什么共同点吗？

lines.en: scene nikiverysad8
: You’re so fucking weak, Akira...so fucking weak.
lines.zh: : 你太他妈软弱了，Akira……太他妈软弱了。

lines.en: : It’d be one thing if I just found weird shit on your computer...but actually sleeping with a girl her age?...
lines.zh: : 如果我只是从你电脑里翻出些奇怪的东西，那是另一回事……可你居然真去睡了她那个年纪的女孩？……

lines.en: : I can’t watch what happened to you again...you were so fucking smart and precious. And Noriko’s so fucking smart too, but now she has to deal with this!
lines.zh: : 我没法再看一遍发生在你身上的事了……你曾经那么他妈的聪明、那么珍贵。Noriko 也一样聪明得要命，可现在她得面对这些！

lines.en: : And sure, she’s giddy and all like, “look at me, I’m a woman” now, but what if she looks back on this in five years and realizes how fucked up it was?
lines.zh: : 当然，她现在飘飘然的，一副「快看我，我是女人了」的样子，可万一五年后她回头看，意识到这有多变态呢？

lines.en: : You want to trash your connection to her too?! Someone who has rooted for you harder than anyone ever?!
lines.zh: : 你也想毁掉跟她之间的联结吗？！一个比所有人都更拼命为你加油的人？！

lines.en: : You were her fucking role model! You still are! So what if she turns around and does this same shit to someone else’s kid in the future?! What if you just created another monster?!
lines.zh: : 你曾经是她他妈的榜样！现在还是！那万一将来她转过身，把同样的事做在别人家孩子身上呢？！万一你刚刚亲手造出了又一个怪物？！

lines.en: : Asking me the same questions I ask myself every day isn’t going to just magically help me come up with an answer.
lines.zh: : 每天拿我问自己的问题来问我，并不会神奇地帮我找出答案。

lines.en: : So she’s not the first then. And you’ve done this before.
lines.zh: : 所以她不是第一个。你以前就做过。

lines.en: : That’s right...
lines.zh: : 没错……

lines.en: : How many times? With who? Because I assume now that’s what had that Maya girl storming out of the house when she found out I was living there. You fuck her too, Akira?
lines.zh: : 多少次？跟谁？因为我现在猜，那个 Maya 发现我住在那儿之后冲出屋去，就是因为这个。你也睡了她吧，Akira？

lines.en: : Yes...I have.
lines.zh: : 是的……睡过。

lines.en: scene nikiverysad9
: Pfft. Un-fucking-believable. Only you could have someone like me begging to be your one-and-only just to turn around and fuck some random high schooler.
lines.zh: : 噗。真他妈难以置信。也就只有你，能让像我这样的人求着当你的唯一，转头你却去睡某个随便的高中生。

lines.en: : My parents should’ve called the cops on that fucking tutor of yours long before she died. But I told them everything was fine. Because I believed you.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈早在她死之前，就该把你那个该死的家庭教师报警抓起来。可我告诉他们一切都好。因为我信你。

lines.en: : I have always believed you. Always just let you do your thing because I had enough faith in you to think you’d be able to fix things on your own. How fucking dumb I was.
lines.zh: : 我一直都信你。一直由着你去做，因为我对你的信心足够多，多到以为你能自己把事情搞定。我他妈的真是蠢透了。

lines.en: : You weren’t dumb, Niki...You were a kid.
lines.zh: : 你不蠢，Niki……你那时只是个孩子。

lines.en: : Yeah, and so were you. But while I was in bed watching Pokemon and painting my nails, you were in bed with a grown woman, learning everything about life except what’s important.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你也是。可当我躺在床上看着宝可梦、涂指甲油的时候，你正躺在一个成年女人床上，学遍了人生的一切，唯独没学到重要的那些。

lines.en: : It wasn’t like that, Niki. She loved me. She really loved me.
lines.zh: : 不是那样的，Niki。她爱我。她是真的爱我。

lines.en: : Yeah, and I’m sure you think you really love Noriko too, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我猜你也觉得自己真的爱 Noriko，对吧？

lines.en: : Because I do.
lines.zh: : 因为我是真的爱。

lines.en: : So what then? It’s okay to fuck whoever you want regardless of their age so long as you convince yourself you love them? Is that the message you’re trying to send me here?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？只要说服自己「我爱他们」，不管对方多大都能睡，是吗？这就是你想传达给我的信息？

lines.en: : Niki, there’s only one message I’m trying to send you right now and it’s the same one you’re trying to send me. That I’m irredeemable and you’re an idiot for still caring this much.
lines.zh: : Niki，我现在只想传达给你一个信息，跟你想传达给我的是同一个：我无可救药，而你蠢到现在还在乎成这样。

lines.en: : But why are you irredeemable?...And how can you not blame that woman for what you’ve turned into? Without her, it would’ve just been you and me. Forever.
lines.zh: : 可你为什么就无可救药？……还有，你怎么能不怪那个女人把你变成了这样？如果没有她，就会只有你和我。永远。

lines.en: : I don’t...know what I’d be without her, though. Because I barely existed before her.
lines.zh: : 可我……不知道没有她我会是什么样。因为在她之前，我几乎不曾存在过。

lines.en: : You existed. You had interests and hobbies and foods that you liked. But her being nicer to you than your mom or your brother doesn’t mean she gave you life.
lines.zh: : 你存在过。你有感兴趣的东西、有爱好、有喜欢的食物。可她对你比你的妈妈或哥哥好，不代表是她给了你生命。

lines.en: : I was nice to you too, Akira. I opened myself up to you in a way I’ve never done with anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我也对你好过啊，Akira。我向你敞开过自己，那种程度我对任何人都没做到过。

lines.en: : And now I finally have to face the fact that the entire time we were together, you were with someone else. Someone who probably made me look like a worthless amateur by comparison.
lines.zh: : 而现在，我终于得面对这个事实：我们在一起的整段时间里，你身边还有别人。那个大概让我相形见绌、像个一文不值的门外汉的人。

lines.en: : Is that why you left when she died? Started hunting? Because I wasn’t good enough? Couldn’t give you what you really wanted? Artificial love instead of the real kind?
lines.zh: : 所以她死后你才离开的吗？才开始狩猎？因为我不够好？给不了你真正想要的东西？人造的爱，而不是真的那种？

lines.en: scene nikiverysad6
: I don’t know what I was doing back then...I was just...
lines.zh: : 我不知道那时候自己在做什么……我只是……

lines.en: : I acted on instinct after she died. And my instinct was to leave you behind.
lines.zh: : 她死之后，我全凭本能行事。而我的本能就是把你抛下。

lines.en: : But why?! Why am I your punching bag?! That can’t be why I was put here, Akira! I’m more than that! Better than that!
lines.zh: : 可为什么？！为什么我要当你的沙袋？！我来到这世上不可能就是为了这个，Akira！我不止于此！我比这更好！

lines.en: : I imagine I thought the same thing back then that I do now...that if I hurt you badly enough, you’ll stop subjecting yourself to this.
lines.zh: : 我想，我当时的想法跟现在一样……只要我伤你伤得够重，你就会停止让自己承受这些。

lines.en: : You and Noriko weren’t supposed to find me again. You guys were supposed to move on...
lines.zh: : 你和 Noriko 本不该再找到我。你们本该往前走……

lines.en: : But here you are, years later, still wrapped up in the same shit that kept me up at night back then. Just now, I’m on the opposite end of things.
lines.zh: : 可多年之后，你还在这儿，依旧困在当年让我夜不能寐的那摊狗屎里。只是现在，我站在了另一端。

lines.en: : But the two of you are exactly where you’ve always been — caught in the middle of my bullshit and trying to jump in front of the gun I aim at myself in exchange for...nothing.
lines.zh: : 而你们两个还在原地——困在我这堆狗屁里，试图扑到我瞄向自己的那把枪前面，换来的却是……什么都没有。

lines.en: : You two love me so much...but I have never given you anything. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你们两个那么爱我……可我从来没给过你们任何东西。我不懂。

lines.en: : You don’t get it because love is more than just an exchange, idiot!
lines.zh: : 你不懂，是因为爱不只是一桩交易，白痴！

lines.en: scene nikiverysad10
: I don’t want to love you! I don’t want to try and be a mom to a creepy red-head in my twenties! I want to focus on myself and my career!
lines.zh: : 我不想爱你！我不想给一个二十多岁的红毛变态当妈！我想专注在自己和我的事业上！

lines.en: : I want to help other girls learn how to sing! I want to start a fashion line and do makeup ads and be on billboards and go to fancy beach inns and get paid lots of money!
lines.zh: : 我想帮别的女孩学唱歌！我想开创时装线、接化妆品广告、上广告牌、去高级海滨旅馆、赚好多好多钱！

lines.en: : I want people to pamper me and tell me I’m great! That I’m pretty! That all those years of hard work were not wasted! But every second I’m with you, I feel like they were!
lines.zh: : 我想让人捧着我、告诉我我很棒！我很漂亮！那些年的努力没有白费！可跟你在一起的每一秒，我都觉得它们全白费了！

lines.en: scene nikiverysad11
: I could conquer the world before making you happy...and I just don’t understand that. Because the logic would dictate here that if I hadn’t gotten through yet, that you just...don’t like me.
lines.zh: : 我大概能征服全世界，也未必能让你幸福……而这一点我怎么都想不通。因为按理说，如果我到现在都没能打动你，那就是你……不喜欢我。

lines.en: : But you do. And I wish that you didn’t because it would make all of this so much easier.
lines.zh: : 可你喜欢我。我真希望你不喜欢，因为那样这一切都会容易得多。

lines.en: : That was my sister, Akira...
lines.zh: : 那是我妹妹啊，Akira……

lines.en: : You didn’t cheat on me with just anybody. It wasn’t just any teenager. It was my sister.
lines.zh: : 你出轨的对象不是随便什么人。不是随便哪个十几岁的孩子。是我妹妹。

lines.en: : Can there be a greater betrayal than this?...What am I supposed to do now? Just...get over it?! Accept that you’re a fucking pig and just...move on?!
lines.zh: : 还有比这更大的背叛吗？……那我现在该怎么办？就这么……翻篇？！接受你是个该死的猪，然后……继续过日子？！

lines.en: : Just...leave...
lines.zh: : 就这么……离开……

lines.en: scene nikiverysad12
: You think I don’t want to?! You think I can walk into a room, see that and think, “Haha! Typical Akira! Hey, everyone! Look at how sad he is! Feel bad for him!” No, moron!
lines.zh: : 你以为我不想吗？！你以为我走进房间、看到那一幕，会想「哈哈！典型的 Akira！嘿，大家！快看他多可怜！同情同情他吧！」才怪，白痴！

lines.en: : I want to fucking kill you right now! I’m so mad that it is taking every ounce of self-restraint in my body to not just strangle you to death!
lines.zh: : 我现在就想杀了你！我气到要用尽全身每一分自制力，才能不直接把你掐死！

lines.en: : But you’re not doing that...because you made a promise to me.
lines.zh: : 可你没有那么做……因为你对我立过誓。

lines.en: scene nikiverysad13
: Because you asked me to make a promise to you...
lines.zh: : 因为你让我向你立誓……

lines.en: : You looked at me, more terrified and helpless than I have ever seen you, and you asked me if I’d really never leave you.
lines.zh: : 你看着我，那是我见过你最恐惧、最无助的样子，然后你问我，是不是真的永远不会离开你。

lines.en: : It’s the only time you have ever asked me for help...and it proved to me that you want me by your side.
lines.zh: : 那是你唯一一次向我求助……而它向我证明了，你想让我留在你身边。

lines.en: : That’s why I took you home that night. And do you remember what happened next?
lines.zh: : 所以那天晚上我把你带回了家。你还记得接下来发生了什么吗？

lines.en: : Of course I remember what happened next...
lines.zh: : 我当然记得接下来发生了什么……

lines.en: : I waited over a decade for that moment. And I thought to myself once we were done that things were going to start getting better.
lines.zh: : 那一刻我等了十多年。等我们做完，我心里想，一切终于要开始好转了。

lines.en: : That you’d open up to me more. That you knew you didn’t need to keep secrets from me...and that I wouldn’t judge you for telling me them.
lines.zh: : 你会对我敞开更多。你会明白不需要对我保守秘密……而我听了也不会评判你。

lines.en: : We both know that’s a lie, though. You were always going to judge me when you found out about this.
lines.zh: : 可我们俩都知道那是谎话。等你发现这件事，你终究是会评判我的。

lines.en: : Maybe. Probably! Because it’s fucking horrible! But that doesn’t mean you should just do it in front of me!
lines.zh: : 也许。大概吧！因为这他妈的太可怕了！可这也不代表你就该当着我的面做！

lines.en: : Yeah, that...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那件事……

lines.en: : I probably...should have stopped when you walked in.
lines.zh: : 我大概……在你进来的时候该停下来的。

lines.en: : You think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Niki...that I’ve done nothing but hurt you. I can promise you that’s the exact opposite of what I-
lines.zh: : 对不起，Niki……我除了伤害你什么都没做。我可以向你保证，那恰恰是我——

lines.en: : Your promises mean literally nothing to me, Akira. They’re worthless. So worthless that you can’t even look me in the eye when you make them.
lines.zh: : 你的承诺对来说简直一文不值，Akira。它们毫无价值。毫无价值到你许下承诺的时候，连看都不敢看我的眼睛。

lines.en: : I’m ashamed...
lines.zh: : 我很羞愧……

lines.en: : Good. You should be ashamed. But what does that mean for me? What do I do now?
lines.zh: : 很好。你是该羞愧。可那对我意味着什么？我现在该怎么办？

lines.en: : Because being there for you doesn’t work. Not being there for you doesn’t work.
lines.zh: : 因为陪在你身边没用。不陪在你身边也没用。

lines.en: : Do you want me to castrate you? Because I will. And I am very tempted to do that right now.
lines.zh: : 你想让我把你阉了吗？因为我真的会。而且我现在非常想这么做。

lines.en: : I’m often tempted to do that myself...Figure it would shave at least 50%% of my problems off.
lines.zh: : 我自己也常常动这个念头……心想这大概能替我削掉至少 50%% 的麻烦。

lines.en: : I’m a coward as always, though. I can’t follow through with it. Imagine it would probably be easier to just kill myself if anything.
lines.zh: : 可我还是一如既往地懦弱。我做不到底。说真的，大概干脆自杀还更容易些。

lines.en: scene nikiverysad14
: You’re an asshole, but...
lines.zh: : 你是个混蛋，不过……

lines.en: : I don’t...think you need to go that far.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你不必走到那一步。

lines.en: : Can you just...
lines.zh: : 你能不能就……

lines.en: : Chain me up or something, please?
lines.zh: : 用链子把我拴起来什么的，拜托？

lines.en: : Is the...temptation really that bad? I don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 那种……冲动真的那么严重吗？我不明白……

lines.en: : I don’t either...but I want it to stop just as badly as you want to stop having feelings for me.
lines.zh: : 我也不明白……可我想让它停下来，跟你希望不再对我有感情一样迫切。

lines.en: : I just...keep going, though. I keep doing it. Even when I know it isn’t good for anyone.
lines.zh: : 可我……就是停不下来。我一直做。哪怕明知这对谁都没好处。

lines.en: : I just can’t stop myself, Niki...I cave every single time.
lines.zh: : 我就是控制不住自己，Niki……每一次我都屈服了。

lines.en: : Akira...
lines.zh: : Akira……

lines.en: : I can’t help you this time.
lines.zh: : 这一次我帮不了你。

lines.en: : Or even...try to since you never accept my help in the first place.
lines.zh: : 甚至……连试都试不了，因为你从一开始就没接受过我的帮助。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : This has gone way too far.
lines.zh: : 这件事已经走得太远了。

lines.en: : And I think that...
lines.zh: : 而我觉得……

lines.en: scene nikiverysad15
: Well...
: Maybe some...time apart will...
lines.zh: : 也许……分开一段时间会……

lines.en: : Help me figure out what I...want to do about...all of this.
lines.zh: : 帮我想清楚，我……想拿这一切怎么办。

lines.en: : Because I love you, but...
lines.zh: : 因为我爱你，可是……

lines.en: : You make it...very hard for me to just...exist sometimes.
lines.zh: : 有时候你让我……很难就这么……存在着。

lines.en: : And not having to worry about me...waking up beside you...how you’ll hurt me next...
lines.zh: : 而不用再担心……醒来时你就在身边……担心你下一次要怎么伤我……

lines.en: : Maybe that’ll be good for you too...
lines.zh: : 也许那对你也有好处……

lines.en: : I take it you’re moving out then?...
lines.zh: : 那你是要搬出去了？……

lines.en: scene nikiverysad16
: I have a...lot of work coming up soon.
lines.zh: : 我……接下来有一大堆工作。

lines.en: : And I didn’t want to say anything about it until I was 100%% sure, but...
lines.zh: : 在百分百确定之前，我本来不想说的，不过……

lines.en: : This next album...is going to be my last.
lines.zh: : 下一张专辑……会是最后一张。

lines.en: scene nikiverysad17
: So there’s a lot of recording and practice and promo stuff that needs to be done, and I-
lines.zh: : 所以有很多录音、练习和宣传工作要做，而我——

lines.en: : You’re quitting?...
lines.zh: : 你要退出？……

lines.en: scene nikiverysad18
: Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : Akira, I’m almost 30. It’s a miracle people still want to see me in a swimsuit at this point.
lines.zh: : Akira，我快 30 了。到了这个地步，还有人想看我穿泳装，已经算是奇迹了。

lines.en: : That’s nothing, though. That’s-
lines.zh: : 那不算什么吧。那是——

lines.en: : It is in the idol world. And besides, with how...drastically my life has changed since you came back into it, I don’t...really think I’m in the right head-space to keep going.
lines.zh: : 在偶像这一行，它就是。而且，自从你重新回到我的生活，它变化得那么……剧烈，我不……觉得自己有合适的心境继续下去了。

lines.en: scene nikiverysad19
: I started doing this to get back at you, remember? And yeah...I love my job. I love sharing my songs with everyone. But nothing...
lines.zh: : 我当初做这个是为了报复你，记得吗？是啊……我爱我的工作。我爱跟大家分享我的歌。可什么都没有……

lines.en: : Nothing comes out...right now that we’ve been reunited. And, no offense, but most of the stuff that’s happened since we have has...kinda sucked.
lines.zh: : 现在我们重逢之后，什么都写不出来了。无意冒犯，但我们重逢之后发生的大多数事……都挺糟的。

lines.en: : And I don’t want that to negatively impact an otherwise...nearly flawless career, so...I figure if I go out with a bang...I can sort of just...well...
lines.zh: : 而我不想让那些事给我原本……近乎完美的职业生涯蒙上阴影，所以……我想，如果我能轰轰烈烈地退场……大概就能……嗯……

lines.en: : My mark’s been made already...
lines.zh: : 我已经留下了自己的印记……

lines.en: : And there’s not much more I can do here, I don’t think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得，我在这里能做的也不多了……

lines.en: : That’s...another reason I wanted to move in with you.
lines.zh: : 那也是……我想搬来跟你住的另一个原因。

lines.en: scene nikiverysad20
: I figured that...once my career was over...I’d have a lot more time for you and Ami and...
lines.zh: : 我原本想……等事业结束之后……我就有更多时间陪你和 Ami，还有……

lines.en: : And we could figure out a way to make this work...
lines.zh: : 而我们可以想办法，让这段关系走下去……

lines.en: : But now you don’t know...and I’ll have destroyed your career for nothing.
lines.zh: : 可现在你也不知道了……而我就这样白白毁了你的事业。

lines.en: : I just need time, okay?...
lines.zh: : 我只是需要时间，好吗？……

lines.en: : So I’m not moving out. I’ll just...be in hotels a little more than normal and...sleep on the couch whenever I’m not.
lines.zh: : 所以我不会搬出去。我只是……会比平时多住些酒店，不在酒店的时候就……睡沙发。

lines.en: : And if you...do need help with anything, I will still be there. I just...
lines.zh: : 而如果你……真有什么需要帮忙的，我还是会在。我只是……

lines.en: : Maybe we should...just be friends again...
lines.zh: : 也许我们该……重新做回朋友……

lines.en: : For a little while...
lines.zh: : 就一段时间……

lines.en: : Akira?...
lines.zh: : Akira？……

lines.en: : That’s okay...right?
lines.zh: : 这样可以吧……对吗？

lines.en: scene black
: You do...whatever it is you need to do. For yourself.
lines.zh: : 你去做……你需要做的任何事吧。为了你自己。

lines.en: : For your art.
lines.zh: : 为了你的艺术。

lines.zh: Niki 的好感度下降了 50！
